order: orders/ENG5S_STATUS_CHECKS.md (G2, G3's GPU half, G4's mutant lines)
environment: the lead's environment with the GPU visible; no ENG5-S script removes or overrides CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (the step refuses with exit 7 if it is empty)
scope: the lead runs each line in a systemd scope with MemoryMax=12G and OOMPolicy=continue; no line sets RLIMIT_AS / ulimit -v / prlimit; no line runs compute-sanitizer
lease_check: scripts/eng5s_gpu_step.py:2 (forge-gpu-lease-check --require-held), repeated as the first statement of each child (G2_CHILD, its line 3)
post_device_steps: scripts/eng5s_gpu_verdict.py (written by the step as VERDICT.json); self-test on constructed rows: artifacts/eng5s/gpu_dry/VERDICT_SELFTEST.json; CPU drive of the children: artifacts/eng5s/gpu_dry/G2_CPU_DRIVE.json
order_of_lines: g3_* first (they read the per-arm packages, not the worktree), then the suite series last (each chunk installs its arm's three engine files and module into the worktree and restores Build S's, sha-checked: L128); run each series' chunks in order until progress.json says complete (later chunks then exit at once)
after_lines_cpu: python3 -B -P scripts/eng5s_arms.py results (MUTANT_RESULTS.json from the verdicts)

expected.g3_B: RECORDED (each injected row returns under its fired injection)
expected.suite: per-ID outcomes identical between gpu_B and gpu_S

semantic_verdict: each line's VERDICT.json decides it; RESULT.json ran_clean only records the exits
